[SWS_Fr_00518] ⌈The function Fr_AllSlots() shall perform the following tasks on
FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:
1. Invoke the CC CHI command ’ALL_SLOTS’, which requests a switch from key
slot only mode to all slots transmission mode at the beginning of the next com-
munication cycle.
2. Return E_OK.
⌋
Note: The function Fr_AllSlots() requests to switch from key slot only mode to all
slots transmission mode at the beginning of the next communication cycle.
